name: wine-comctl32-mbtowc-byte-count
fixed_note: The last argument to MultiByteToWideChar is wide character count and not the buffer size in bytes: comctl32 passed sizeof(szTitle) for a WCHAR[256] (propsheet.c), (len+1)*sizeof(WCHAR) (toolbar.c) and buflen = max(len*sizeof(WCHAR), ...) (treeview.c), letting the conversion write up to twice past the buffer. The same commit left LoadStringW(..., sizeof(szTitle)) and GetWindowTextW(..., sizeof(buffer)) in these files, which are also reported (not sinks).
